# 1. Edit an existing screen - add a new field (use case 5-6-7)


## Introduction.

This is a specific feature described in  Assign Courier

The task involved in adding two parameters for a courier


- 1.  Threshold: It refers to alerting and is expressed as a percentage. A courier is assigned a given Range of Numbers for delivering parcels. Each new delivery consumes a Range Number. Threshold signifies what is the minimum number of Range Numbers left before raising an alert for renewing the Range Numbers.
- e.g. If the courier named LDH is given a span of 1000 Range Numbers, with a Threshold of 20%,
- having a Start Range Number:1000 and an End Range Number: 2000, then when the consumed Range Number has reached the value of 1800, an alert will be raised for renewing the range numbers.
- 2.  Status: If the courier is Enabled or Disable in the sense whether it can be used or not.


The first task was first to identify whether his kind of functionality is offered from PowerCard or identify where we could intervene as to provide this functionality.

The screen of in Issuing / Parameters / Embossing seemed to fit the requirements. "Delivery supplier code"

The Browser assist us in locating the code. In case of Chrome we use More Tools  Developer Tools.

The open a debug window showing the posting of the page.

For the  U.I. we look under the submenu of the Sources Developer Tools:

In order to locate the element on the U.I., simply select and element (=input box), right click on the element and from the pop up menu select " " Inspect

For the Server we look under the submenu of the Network Developer Tools:

In order to get a request from the server pressing a button e.g. "Search" button will do the job in reveling the server side component.

For the Server the path where changes need to place is: paramsCardholder/Delivery_supplier_codeService
